nodes.description: Owner address state variable defined in Ownable; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address in Ownable; set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Pausable pause flag; gates transfer/multiTransfer/transferFrom/approve via whenNotPaused.
Internal total token supply; increased by mint and decreased by burn.
Mapping of holder balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, distribute, burn and mint.
Mapping of frozen accounts; managed by freezeAccount/unfreezeAccount and checked by notFrozen.
Nested allowance mapping; written by approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance and read by transferFrom.
Address of the delegatecall implementation target; set by _setImplementation via upgradeTo and read by the fallback.
Maximum mintable supply cap; checked in mint to bound totalSupply_.
Initial supply constant used in the constructor to derive totalSupply_ and mintCap.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) with onlyOwner; sets newOwner after zero-address check.
Ownable.acceptOwnership() with onlyNewOwner; promotes newOwner to owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Pausable.pause() with onlyOwner and whenNotPaused; sets paused=true.
Pausable.unpause() with onlyOwner and whenPaused; sets paused=false.
VTO.upgradeTo(address) with onlyOwner; replaces the delegatecall implementation address.
Internal helper writing the new implementation address into storage.
Payable fallback function that delegatecalls calldata to the implementation address via inline assembly.
ERC20.totalSupply() view returning totalSupply_.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256) whenNotPaused/notFrozen(msg.sender); moves balances with SafeMath.
Batch transfer iterating over parallel address and amount arrays, calling transfer per entry.
ERC20.balanceOf(address) view returning balances[_holder].
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) whenNotPaused/notFrozen(_from); uses and decrements allowance.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256) whenNotPaused; sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Increases allowance of spender by addedValue using SafeMath.add.
Decreases allowance of spender by subtractedValue using SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[_holder][_spender].
Owner-only function setting frozen[_holder]=true.
Owner-only function setting frozen[_holder]=false.
Owner-only balance transfer from the caller to _to using SafeMath.
Owner-only function performing an external call token.transfer(_to,_value) on an arbitrary ERC20.
Owner-only burn decrementing the caller balance and totalSupply_.
Owner-only mint capped by mintCap; increases totalSupply_ and balances[_to].
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance ownership and approvals.
Inline-assembly delegatecall in the fallback to the implementation address with attacker-supplied calldata.
Supply and balance arithmetic (SafeMath add/sub and unmetered multiplication in constructor) affecting token accounting.
Untrusted external call to an arbitrary ERC20 token inside claimToken.
New owner candidate passed to transferOwnership.
New implementation address passed to upgradeTo.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
transferOwnership relies on onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with owner.
acceptOwnership relies on onlyNewOwner requiring msg.sender == newOwner.
pause is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
upgradeTo is guarded by onlyOwner and lets the owner replace arbitrary implementation code.
Fallback is unauthenticated and delegatecalls attacker-supplied calldata preserving msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and checks notFrozen(msg.sender).
multiTransfer checks notFrozen(msg.sender) and forwards transfers from the caller.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseAllowance mutates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance mutates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
freezeAccount is guarded by onlyOwner.
unfreezeAccount is guarded by onlyOwner.
distribute is guarded by onlyOwner and debits balances[msg.sender].
claimToken is guarded by onlyOwner but moves arbitrary tokens via an external call.
burn is guarded by onlyOwner and debits balances[msg.sender].
mint is guarded by onlyOwner and can create new supply.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner value.
pause authorization depends on the stored owner.
unpause authorization depends on the stored owner.
upgradeTo authorization depends on the stored owner.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner slot.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and then promotes it to owner.
pause requires !paused and sets paused = true.
unpause requires paused and sets paused = false.
whenNotPaused gates transfer on the paused flag.
whenNotPaused gates multiTransfer on the paused flag.
whenNotPaused gates transferFrom on the paused flag.
whenNotPaused gates approve on the paused flag.
notFrozen(msg.sender) consults the frozen mapping in transfer.
notFrozen(msg.sender) consults the frozen mapping in multiTransfer.
notFrozen(_from) consults the frozen mapping in transferFrom.
freezeAccount sets the frozen flag for a holder.
unfreezeAccount clears the frozen flag for a holder.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to] before SafeMath updates.
transfer writes the debited and credited balances.
balanceOf returns balances[_holder].
transferFrom reads and updates the from/to balances.
transferFrom writes the adjusted balances.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseAllowance adds to the stored allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the stored allowance.
allowance returns allowed[_holder][_spender].
totalSupply returns totalSupply_.
burn decrements totalSupply_ by the burned value.
mint increments totalSupply_ subject to mintCap.
mint requires mintCap >= totalSupply_.add(_amount).
upgradeTo compares and replaces the implementation pointer.
Fallback requires implementation != address(0) and uses it as the delegatecall target.
The implementation address is the delegatecall destination, so ownership of it controls arbitrary code execution.
upgradeTo invokes _setImplementation.
_setImplementation writes the implementation storage slot.
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer for each recipient/amount pair.
freezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = true.
unfreezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = false.
distribute mutates the balances mapping from the owner account.
burn rewrites totalSupply_ after debiting the burner.
mint rewrites totalSupply_ after the cap check.
Fallback performs an assembly delegatecall into the implementation, which can re-enter the contract and mutate this contract's storage.
claimToken performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 token, allowing a malicious token to re-enter before returning.
transfer performs SafeMath add/sub on balances.
transferFrom performs SafeMath add/sub on balances and allowances.
mint performs SafeMath add on totalSupply_ and balances.
burn performs SafeMath sub on the balance and totalSupply_.
_newOwner parameter is validated and stored into newOwner.
_newImplementation is passed through to _setImplementation.
_to is the transfer recipient and validated against address(0).
_value bounds-checked against balances[msg.sender] and subtracted.
_toList is iterated and each entry passed to transfer.
_valueList entries drive the per-iteration transfer amounts.
_holder indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
_from indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_to is the transferFrom recipient validated against address(0).
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is written verbatim into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
spender indexes the allowance mapping mutated by increaseAllowance.
addedValue is added to the stored allowance.
spender indexes the allowance mapping mutated by decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the stored allowance.
_holder indexes the outer allowance mapping.
_spender indexes the inner allowance mapping.
_holder is the account written as frozen by freezeAccount.
_holder is the account cleared as unfrozen by unfreezeAccount.
_to is the distribute recipient validated against address(0).
_value is subtracted from the owner balance and added to the recipient.
token is the arbitrary ERC20 contract whose transfer is invoked.
_to is the recipient passed to the external token transfer.
_value is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
_value is subtracted from the burner balance and totalSupply_.
_to receives the newly minted balance.
_amount is added to totalSupply_ and balances[_to].
balance local holds the balanceOf return value sourced from balances.
burner local caches msg.sender for the balance write in burn.
Loop counter i drives the multiTransfer iteration bound.
impl local caches the implementation storage value in the fallback.
ptr local is the memory cursor for calldatacopy/returndatacopy in the fallback.
result local holds the outcome of the delegatecall that may have re-entered the contract.
size local bounds the returndatasize copied back after the delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a parameter of transferOwnership and has no independent identity; fold it into the owning function.
_newImplementation is only used to configure the implementation pointer through upgradeTo.
_to is a transient recipient argument of transfer.
_value is a transient amount argument of transfer.
_toList is a transient input array of multiTransfer.
_valueList is a transient input array of multiTransfer.
_holder is a read-only lookup key in balanceOf.
_from is a transient source argument of transferFrom.
_to is a transient destination argument of transferFrom.
_value is a transient amount argument of transferFrom.
_spender is a transient approval target in approve.
_value is the transient allowance value set by approve.
spender is a transient argument of increaseAllowance.
addedValue is a transient argument of increaseAllowance.
spender is a transient argument of decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is a transient argument of decreaseAllowance.
_holder is a read-only lookup key in allowance.
_spender is a read-only lookup key in allowance.
_holder is the target account frozen by freezeAccount.
_holder is the target account unfrozen by unfreezeAccount.
_to is a transient recipient argument of distribute.
_value is a transient amount argument of distribute.
token is the untrusted external contract invoked by claimToken.
_to is a transient recipient argument of claimToken.
_value is a transient amount argument of claimToken.
_value is the burn amount consumed by burn.
_to is a transient mint recipient argument.
_amount is a transient mint amount argument.
balance is a pure return alias for the balanceOf storage read.
burner is only a cached alias of msg.sender inside burn.
i is a loop-scoped counter inside multiTransfer.
impl is a transient cache of the implementation slot in the fallback.
ptr is a memory-scoped assembly pointer inside the fallback.
result is the delegatecall status flag and has meaning only within the delegatecall operation.
size is the returndata length produced by the delegatecall operation.
